## TerraScale fork line

First release of the operator fork. The version page now tracks this repository instead of upstream GitHub, and the release manifest ships with the deployed build.

- Renamed kuayle → ku; deployed as the HomeLab `ku` service
- MCP server (44 tools) with personal API keys
- Screen sharing rebuilt peer-to-peer over ku's workspace WebSocket (no media server)
- Rate-limit removal for shared-egress users

Source: https://git.terrascale.tech/TerraScale/ku
